2607.14197.title: How Artificial Intelligence LLM Engines Shape the Global Conflict Information Environment
2607.14197.paper_summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) answer engines now field a growing share of the questions that analysts, scholars, and the public ask about issues of peace and conflict. Large Language Models (LLMs) are known to hallucinate under certain conditions, but do these errors have discernible patterns when they are asked about conflicts, and if so what can that teach us about the changing global conflict information environment? To answer, we first asked a battery of questions about 28 conflicts to five leading answer engines and scored their 5,460 answers against documented evidence. We found that the thinner the retrievable record around a given conflict, the more the engines invent, misattribute, and miscount. Thin records don't just encourage hallucination, but create structural exposure to mis- and disinformation, because they are the easiest records to warp through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to bias engine responses. Through an analysis of 1,048 websites that the AI LLMs pulled conflict facts from, we found that GEO source optimization is already happening, and while state-partisan digital capture remains incipient it is rapidly growing. We explain what these findings mean for scholarship with the rise of GEO information warfare, and for policy argue for a return to the deep local monitoring and translation-based research that AI tools cannot replicate, closing with a discussion of future research opportunities and challenges in this fast-moving space.
2607.14197.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧（AI）回答引擎現在處理越來越多的問題，這些問題來自分析師、學者和公眾，涉及和平與衝突的議題。大型語言模型（LLMs）在某些條件下會出現幻覺，但當它們被詢問有關衝突的問題時，這些錯誤是否有明顯的模式？如果有，這可以教會我們關於不斷變化的全球衝突資訊環境什麼？為了回答這個問題，我們首先向五個主要的回答引擎提出了關於28個衝突的一系列問題，並將它們的5,460個回答與已記錄的證據進行了評分。我們發現，關於某一衝突的可檢索記錄越薄，這些引擎就越會發明、錯誤歸因和錯誤計算。薄弱的記錄不僅促進了幻覺的產生，還造成了對錯誤和虛假資訊的結構性暴露，因為這些記錄是通過生成引擎優化（GEO）來扭曲引擎回應的最容易的記錄。通過分析AI LLMs從中提取衝突事實的1,048個網站，我們發現GEO來源優化已經在發生，儘管國家偏見的數位捕獲仍然處於初期階段，但它正在迅速增長。我們解釋了這些發現對學術界在GEO資訊戰爭興起下的意義，並對政策提出了回歸深度本地監測和基於翻譯的研究的建議，這是AI工具無法複製的，最後討論了在這個快速變化的領域中的未來研究機會和挑戰。
2607.14197.author: Jason Miklian et.al.
